verdict.rationale: Convertio is a browser-based file-conversion service, and a built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for this kind of SaaS product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only manual drag-and-drop conversion, an API, a CLI, and OCR. Nothing documents an in-product AI assistant that tasks can be delegated to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
